// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// types / primitives / aliases characters numbers nullish and unknown
type Scalar = boolean | char | string | int32 | uint64 | float64 | bigint | symbol | void | unknown;
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds

type Empty = never | null | undefined;
//           ^^^^^ keyword.other.type.ds

const key: unique symbol = Symbol("key");
//         ^^^^^^ keyword.other.modifier.ds
